# Portfolix v0.1.10 (Build 22)
## 新功能
- 新增投资云图：在“今日盈亏”和“投资分布”之间切换，以矩形面积呈现各资产的当日盈亏，或通过 AI 分析底层投资领域及其金额与占比。 - 投资分布随行情更新，并优先复用已有分类；未启用 AI、缺少有效密钥或分析失败时，按资产类别展示。 - 搜索 API 新增 DeepSeek Search 开关，复用 DeepSeek API Key，支持与 Parallel Search、Tavily、博查同时启用，由 Agent 按需选择并在失败时回退。
## 优化与修复
- 统一浅色与深色模式下的文字层级、卡片底色、选中状态和 Liquid Glass 按钮、选择器质感；保留旧版 macOS 的兼容外观。 - 统一卡片内边距和标题、控件对齐，移除卡片外侧描边，优化侧边栏、弹出窗口及持仓表格的视觉一致性。 - “每日盈亏”更名为“盈亏日历”，优化月份显示和日历底部间距，并调整其与投资云图的布局顺序。 - 持仓占比改为按累计市值达到 90% 展示，其余合并为“其他”；悬停时显示对应金额，并去除柱状图灰色衬底和描边。 - 移除旧投资画像、资产配置和计价币种分布卡片，清理旧画像的 AI 评分流程。 - 智能分析输入区使用动态圆形按钮：空白时生成分析，输入文字后切换为发送。 - 修复投资云图等显示选择未能持久保存的问题，优化持仓表格选择时的闪烁及相关稳定性。 - 简化搜索配置说明，统一 Tavily 与 DeepSeek 的密钥验证提示文案、图标及状态颜色。
DeepSeek Search 为独立计费服务，默认关闭。启用前请确认 DeepSeek 账户的服务可用性及费用。
## New Features
- Added the Investment Map, with Today's P&L and Distribution modes. Tile areas represent absolute daily gains or losses, or AI-assisted underlying investment-sector allocations with amounts and percentages. - Distribution updates with market data and reuses existing classifications. Asset-category distributions remain available when AI is disabled, credentials are unavailable, or analysis fails. - Added DeepSeek Search using the existing DeepSeek API key. Enable it alongside Parallel Search, Tavily, and Bocha, with agent-selected routing and provider fallback.
## Improvements and Fixes
- Unified text hierarchy, card surfaces, selection states, and Liquid Glass buttons and selectors in light and dark appearances, with compatible rendering on earlier macOS versions. - Standardized card padding and header alignment, removed outer card borders, and improved consistency across the sidebar, sheets, and holdings tables. - Renamed Daily P&L to P&L Calendar, improved month labels and bottom spacing, and rearranged the calendar and investment-map cards. - Holding Mix now shows holdings up to 90% of cumulative market value and groups the remainder as Other, displays hovered amounts, and removes the gray chart backing and outline. - Removed the retired investment-profile, asset-allocation, and quote-currency cards, along with the old AI radar-scoring workflow. - Added a dynamic circular composer button that generates analysis when empty and sends a question when text is entered. - Persisted display selections and improved holdings-table selection stability and flicker behavior. - Simplified search configuration descriptions and aligned Tavily validation messages, icons, and colors with DeepSeek.
DeepSeek Search is billed separately and is disabled by default. Check service availability and pricing before enabling it.
